title: All-q Levi flag distance scheme, cycle rank, and Hodge primitive idempotent
purpose: Lift the q=3 Levi-flag association/Hodge stack to every generalized quadrangle of order (q,q): identify the flag line graph distance array and shell sizes, derive its spectrum, prove the -2 eigenspace is exactly the Levi cycle space of dimension q^4, derive the radial primitive-idempotent numerator (q^4,-q^3,q^2,-q,1), recover the W33 81-dimensional projector as q=3, and connect this carefully to the published flag association-scheme literature without claiming priority for the underlying symmetric fusion.
outcomes: Established the flag line-graph intersection array {2q,q,q,q;1,1,1,2} and shell sizes 1,2q,2q^2,2q^3,q^4.
Derived spectrum 2q, q-1+sqrt(2q), q-1, q-1-sqrt(2q), -2 with multiplicities 1, q(q+1)^2/2, q(q^2+1), q(q+1)^2/2, q^4.
Proved D^T D=2I+A_X for the consistently oriented Levi incidence matrix, hence ker D is exactly the -2 eigenspace and has dimension q^4.
Derived the terminal first-eigenmatrix row (1,-2,2,-2,1), terminal second-eigenmatrix column (q^4,-q^3,q^2,-q,1), and Hodge projector E_-2=(q^4A0-q^3A1+q^2A2-qA3+A4)/((q+1)^2(q^2+1)).
Recovered the W33 q=3 shells 1,6,18,54,81 and projector numerator 81,-27,9,-3,1 exactly, linking the all-q result to BT545-BT551.
Added deterministic verifier, frozen certificate, regression tests, manuscript insert, public card source, publication-contract registration, and replay/compile workflow.
boundary: The symmetric 4-class flag fusion and its valencies are prior art (Colangelo-Monzillo-Siciliano, Discrete Mathematics 347 (2024), 114054). This packet claims the explicit all-q Hodge/cycle-space bridge and W33 specialization, not priority for the underlying association scheme. No quantum-code distance, threshold, or laboratory protection theorem is inferred. GitHub Actions was still queued at closure time, so remote CI success is not claimed.
